title: OpenFocus: An Open-Source Multi-Focus Image Fusion Workstation
description: OpenFocus is an open-source multi-focus image fusion workstation. It combines homography and ECC image registration with five fusion algorithms (guided filter, DCT, dual-tree complex wavelet transform, GFG-FGF and the StackMFF-V4 deep model), supports 8- and 16-bit image stacks, HEIC input, batch processing, project files and a wipe-compare inspection view. Ready-to-run builds are provided for Windows and macOS (Apple Silicon), and the full pipeline is installable from PyPI as a headless command-line tool (pip install openfocus).
